name: Copart (CPRT)
teaser: Copart earned a 35.4% operating margin on 0.4% revenue growth while units fell 5.5%, then spent $1.9 billion in cash on ACV Auctions. At $31.09 the shares sit 1.1% above my Base value of $30.74, so I call it Hold.
llms: Copart (CPRT) runs online auctions for salvage vehicles and bought ACV Auctions for about $1.9 billion in October 2026. Valued on ten years of discounted free cash flow to the firm and an exit multiple on EBITDA. Bear $21.05, Base $30.74, Bull $42.04. Verdict: hold at $31.09, maximum buy price $17.68. Conditional on results due December 1, 2026.
